title: Extra Crispy Spiced Kenyan Chicken Tagine
description: A rich, crispy, one-pot Kenyan dish featuring unwaxed lime, brine-wet chicken, and halal-friendly spices.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large Talavera plate over medium heat.
Add diced red onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add habanero pepper and cook for another minute.
Add chicken thighs and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add garam masala, ground cumin, ground coriander, salt, and black pepper. Cook for 1 minute.
Add chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
In a separate bowl, mix flour and water to make a slurry.
Add the slurry to the tagine and stir to combine.
Increase heat to medium-high and cook, uncovered, until the sauce thickens and the chicken is crispy, about 10 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with unwaxed lime wedges and chopped fresh cilantro, if desired.
